otterSecBinaryVerification.baseImageBuildContext: Custom verifier image built from solanafoundation/solana-verifiable-build:3.0.12 with Solana CLI replaced by 3.1.14 + platform-tools v1.52 (rustc 1.89). Dockerfile lives at solana/scripts/verifier-image/Dockerfile.
otterSecBinaryVerification.programsUpgraded: After the initial deploy, all 5 programs were upgraded with bytecode produced inside the verifier image (solana program deploy --program-id <existing-keypair>), so the on-chain hash equals the canonical image-build hash. Upgrade preserved every program id and all initialized state (config PDAs, mint, MINTER role).
otterSecBinaryVerification.explorerEffect: Solscan, SolanaFM, and Solana Explorer all show the green 'Verified' badge with source link to github.com/stablenaira/core@60e5cfb. Anyone can reproduce: `solana-verify build --base-image ghcr.io/stablenaira/solana-verifiable-build:3.1.14-v1.52 --library-name <name> .` from the repo root and compare `solana-verify get-executable-hash <so>` to `solana-verify get-program-hash <programId>`.

_state: INITIALIZED. All 4 stateful programs are configured (crypto_parity is stateless). SNR Token-2022 mint live; bridge can burn-from depositors via the MINTER role PDA. No remote routers are registered yet, so cross-chain depositForBurn / receiveMessage calls revert with UnregisteredRemoteRouter — bridge is functionally idle until peer routes are wired to BSC/Ethereum/Base/Asset Chain mainnet TokenMessengers and reciprocal Solana-side routes are added.
_caveats: Same program keypair files (target/deploy/<name>-keypair.json) are used across localnet/devnet/mainnet per Anchor.toml. Anyone with access to those keypair files can also deploy/upgrade at the same address on any cluster they have funds on. The .so binaries were built today (2026-05-21) from main; no third-party audit at the time of deploy (commit history tags Phase 7 as 'audit-prep'). Validator set is a single signer (0x2503), same leaked-key posture as EVM. Multisig migration of upgrade authority + admin authority remains the operational priority.

Register each EVM mainnet TokenMessenger as a remote router on token_messenger via set_remote_router (no timelock on Solana side)
Wire EVM MessageTransmitter remote routers to recognise Solana's (chain_id, transmitter) identity above
Move upgrade authority and admin authority to Squads multisig once available
